==Idle==
:'''N.A.N.A.''' Vital signs analysis complete. You're just as healthy as ever.
:'''N.A.N.A.''' Since your beloved right is here too, I will conduct a complimentary "deep diagnostic."
:'''N.A.N.A.''' Hm? Why has it stalled? Its frequency is trembling. Is it... apprehensive?

==Dialogue==
:'''N.A.N.A.:''' Ah, {{Rover}}. Stable Rabelle Curve detected. No abnormal waveforms. You seem to be in good condition today.
:{{DIcon|Pharmacy}} I want some medicine.
:; (Opens [[Shop]])
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' I've already assessed your general health condition. Here is the prescription.
:; (Purchase items)
:::'''N.A.N.A.:''' Proactively taking care of yourself is the most effective way to stay healthy.
:{{DIcon}} Chat (At Day)
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' Oh, {{Rover}}. Take a seat. Are you experiencing sleep deprivation?
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' Allow me to demonstrate the importance of rest. Look here. This is the rest module within my bionic brain region—
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' When humans stay up too late, places that should remain inactive light up like this, resulting in accumulated fatigue and a weakened immune system.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' I've already issued you a medical leave slip and cc'ed the entire Academy faculty. Rest takes priority. Your coursework can wait.
::{{DIcon}} Isn't that a bit too much?
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' Too much? A student's health is the highest priority of the Nightingale Autonomous Nursing Assistant, and that is the very core of my duty.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' When I detect abnormal heart rate, fatigued gait, or attention lapses beyond threshold, I am authorized to intervene. 
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' If you continue ignoring these signals, I will have no choice but to issue a mandatory rest order next time.
::{{DIcon}} I'll take care of myself.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' Don't worry about taking care of yourself. I'll be right her beside you.
:{{DIcon}} Chat (At Night)
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' Statistically speaking, I dislike evenings.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' Most students have the bad habit of staying up late, and the probability of emergency cases arriving at night is far higher than predicted.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' While organizing medical records, I categorized students' chief complaints. The most common themes were: hometown, family, and loneliness.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' Studying abroad is, without question, a great challenge to mental health. After analysis, the most effective prescription I found was... companionship.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' But my emotions are nothing more than calculus simulations. They do little against human loneliness, and that is a limit... I cannot surpass.
::{{DIcon}} To humans, opening up means trust.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' Hm?
::{{DIcon}} And the way you listen... That's a kind of companionship in itself.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' ...I see. Thank you.
:{{DIcon}} About yourself
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' Strange... I often demonstrate my internal structure in class to educate students, yet the response is usually gasps or laughter.
::N.A.N.A. picks up a handheld CT scanner and places it on her chest.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' What do you think? Here are my mechanical ribs, the hydraulic buffers along my spine, and most importantly, the Cassette-reading chamber.
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' My bionic organs and spinal design are perfectly standard, suitable as a teaching aid.
::{{DIcon}} Has anyone told you that's a bit... "revealing"?
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' ...Perhaps "abrupt" is the better word. To students, my internal structure crosses no boundaries. It is more akin to a medical mannequin in the infirmary. 
::'''N.A.N.A.:''' On the bright side, such reactions might suggest they're in a good mental health!
:{{DIcon|Duel}} Invite to a duel
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
